Start a new chapter BEFORE any unit with terminal=YES. That means before unit 5? Terminal YES on unit 5 => start new chapter before unit 5. So after which unit does the new chapter begin? After previous unit (unit 4). So new_chapter_after includes 4.

Also start a new chapter BEFORE any unit with reset=YES. None have reset=YES, so no more.

Never create boundary before unit 1: already starting at unit 1.

Otherwise keep unit in current chapter.

Thus only one new chapter after unit 4. That means chapters: Chapter1 units 1-4; Chapter2 units5-6.

Return JSON with key "new_chapter_after" listing unit numbers AFTER which a new chapter begins. So array [4].

Check if any other boundaries? Terminal=YES on unit5, reset=NO. Also terminal=YES maybe also before unit5 only. No others.
